reviews.comment: I took her for HIST-201. She is an very caring professor and easily approachable. There are no exams in this class so as long as you just show up, put in the effort, and talk in class, it's basically impossible not to get an A in her class. Very flexible with her guidelines as well as she is incredibly understanding for others.

GO TO CLASS! TAKE NOTES! 3 tests (you can bring in a notecard), weekly hw (easy), 1 essay. She is nice, if you need help, go to her office hours. She is well-versed in the subject and kind. Her lectures can be annoying/long but she gives breaks during class. I would say her political views are obvious, but she doesn't present them in that way.

I am not much of a history person- and I am not good at it- but seriously take this class if you can!! Dr. Smith Cox is VERY caring and understands when something comes up with life, school, etc. Her phrase is to “be a good human” and she seriously lives up to it. I missed a few classes and she caught me up plus helped me with the upcoming exam.

(HIST 105) don't really find her amusing. don't like her lectures at all, she's really boring. do go to class bc if u don't u fail as most of her slides are empty and only pics. unnecessarily breaks everyday. no study guide. only advantage is u can use a notecard for exams!! graded on so little, the exams have 18-25(?) questions so easy to fail.

Take her class if you can. She is caring, considerate, and easily accessible. I thoroughly enjoyed her class as well as her teaching style. She is very authentic and translucent in her teachings (especially when talking about wars). She does not sugarcoat the truth, however, she also does not push her own narrative within the classroom either.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class
